:"disclosure","text":"邱苇按暗礁规约引船避开第七根石桩，避险目标完成；许汐仍依据常用图建议在那里停船。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-VFDJ","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Adca2011a-a3b7-4601-a1e2-98d9f68db7ee:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:dca2011a-a3b7-4601-a1e2-98d9f68db7ee"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["邱苇按暗礁规约引船避开第七根石桩，避险目标完成；许汐仍依据常用图建议在那里停船。"]},{"documentId":"D5","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"旧航志只在附记中写过一次：南岸第七根石桩有双点刻痕，刻痕标记暗礁，不是泊位。航行规约写明：确认有暗礁的标记处禁止靠泊。船舷刷着一层青灰漆。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-VFDJ","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Ae091a60c-26b8-4fd7-a51e-1ed47ccd6d99:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:e091a60c-26b8-4fd7-a51e-1ed47ccd6d99"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["旧航志只在附记中写过一次：南岸第七根石桩有双点刻痕，刻痕标记暗礁，不是泊位。航行规约写明：确认有暗礁的标记处禁止靠泊。船舷刷着一层青灰漆。"]},{"documentId":"D6","title":"邱苇","kind":"entity","text":"邱苇","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"aliases":[],"canonicalLabel":"邱苇","entityType":"character","sourceIdentity":{"resourceKind":"character","sourceUid":"res:v1:character:660930fd-dc30-46fe-aa92-6a3c48816b3c","subKey":"root"}},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["邱苇"]},{"documentId":"D7","title":"许汐","kind":"entity","text":"许汐","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"aliases":[],"canonicalLabel":"许汐","entityType":"character","sourceIdentity":{"resourceKind":"character","sourceUid":"res:v1:character:8015af5f-528f-4e72-8996-04bbf924bc27","subKey":"root"}},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["许汐"]}]}
